body.message:
Good afternoon Alexandros,

We completely understand your frustration and sincerely apologize for the delay and inconvenience caused.

We have checked with our Finance Team, and the payment was processed on 16 September. As advised, security deposit refunds are released between Monday and Thursday after the required management approval.

Based on the current process, you should receive the refund next week between Monday and Thursday. We sincerely apologize for the delay, as the remaining timeframe is subject to the management and Finance Team’s approval process, which is beyond our direct control.

Please be assured that we are following up with the team and will keep you updated.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
